data.name: Sense Perfection
data.description: At will, you can detect life forces as if using a paladin's detect evil class ability; however, instead of sensing evil creatures, you sense creatures that have a ki pool. Each such creature has an aura like a cleric of an aligned deity, and treats its current number of ki points as its Hit Dice for the purposes of this ability.
